description: This Java source file defines the DataEvents class, which handles various data-related operations in the OFBiz content management framework. It includes methods for uploading images, streaming binary content to a browser, serving images, and creating or updating data resources. The class interacts with the database entities such as Content and DataResource, and performs security checks, content streaming, and service calls for data management.

classes.name: DataEvents
classes.description: Contains static methods to handle content data events such as uploading images, streaming content, serving images, and creating/updating DataResource entities within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: uploadImage
methods.description: Handles image upload requests, delegating to DataResourceWorker to upload and store the image resource.

methods.name: serveObjectData
methods.description: Streams binary content data associated with a content ID to the browser, with security checks and permission validation.

methods.name: serveImage
methods.description: Streams image data resources directly to the HTTP response output stream, with permission checks. Deprecated in favor of serveObjectData.

methods.name: persistDataResource
methods.description: Creates or updates a DataResource entity based on request parameters, enabling both creation and modification workflows.
